instruction: Take a screenshot of the current video frame in VLC and save it as a PNG file named 'movie_frame.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a screenshot from VLC and saving it as a PNG file. Evaluator checks that the file exists at the correct location and is a valid PNG format. Custom getter get_image_file_exists__7c0cc95089263e14cb308f3757c8acc1 verifies file existence and PNG format.
